Module io.github.brantunger.unruly

Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.mvel

@NullMarked package io.github.brantunger.unruly.mvel
MVEL 2 as an expression language for the engine: MvelExpressionLanguage, named mvel. A RulesEngineBuilder not given a language with language(...) finds it with ServiceLoader, through this artifact's service file on the class path or its module's provides clause. A rule whose language is null is written in MVEL when MVEL is the engine's only language, or when RulesEngineBuilder.defaultLanguage(String) names it.

MVEL optimizer: the engine leaves MVEL's global optimizer setting alone. Concurrent runs never share a session, and an MVEL session holds the run's own compiled expressions, because MVEL replaces the accessors cached in one without synchronization when a fact's runtime class changes. So they are safe with any optimizer, including MVEL's default JIT optimizer.

Types in this package are non-null unless annotated Nullable.
